name: Black Garlic Cloves
descriptions: Soft, caramelized garlic cloves with a sweet, molasses-like umami.
Aged and fermented until black; mellow, almost balsamic in flavor.
Used as a garnish, spread, or an umami-rich ingredient in plant-based dishes.
effects: A rich, sweet umami coats your tongue; the sharp bite of fresh garlic is gone.
Leaves a lingering savory warmth that enhances vegetable dishes and spreads.

name: Fresh Sea Grapes (Umibudo)
descriptions: Tiny translucent green beads that pop with a briny, mineral burst.
A coastal delicacy from warm seas — salty, slightly vegetal, and highly hydrating.
Best eaten raw or as a bright garnish for salads and rice dishes.
effects: Each bead bursts with a saline spray that refreshes the palate.
Leaves you feeling light and oddly refreshed, like a sip of seawater tempered into food.

name: Ripe Jackfruit Chunks (ready-to-eat)
descriptions: Tender, fibrous pieces of jackfruit with tropical sweetness and a mango-like aroma.
Versatile: sweet when ripe, but strains or young fruit are used as meaty texture in savory dishes.
Packed and ready to eat as a fruit snack or blended into plant-based recipes.
effects: A hefty, satisfying bite that fills you without feeling greasy.
Sweet tropical notes lift your mood and add bright flavor to desserts or bowls.

name: Red Miso Paste (jar)
descriptions: A deeply savory, fermented soybean paste with a pronounced salty and savory depth.
Staple ingredient for broths, marinades, and dressings — fermented, probiotic-rich, and intense.
Use sparingly raw or diluted into soups and sauces.
effects: An immediate wall of savory saltiness that amplifies other plant flavors.
Gives a comforting depth to broths; a little goes a long way.

name: Black Sesame Paste
descriptions: Silky, nutty paste made from roasted black sesame seeds; earthy, slightly bitter, and rich.
Used as a spread, dessert filling, or savory condiment in many Asian-influenced recipes.
Dense and caloric — a little adds significant body and flavor.
effects: A toasty, nutty mouthfeel that lingers and rounds out sweeter or savory dishes.
Feels indulgent and substantial despite being plant-based.

name: Pickled Nopal Cactus Pads (nopalitos)
descriptions: Tender cactus pads preserved with a light vinegar brine; green, tangy, and slightly mucilaginous when cooked.
Common in Mexican and Southwestern cuisines; adds a vegetal, lime-accented bite.
Ready to toss into salads, tacos, or stews.
effects: A pleasantly vegetal, slightly slimy texture that pairs well with acidic dressings.
Leaves a cooling, green aftertaste that brightens heavier components.

name: Roasted Sacha Inchi Seeds
descriptions: Crunchy, roasted seeds high in plant protein and omega-rich oils; nutty and satisfying.
Often described as a cross between peanuts and pumpkin seeds, but with a clean, toasted finish.
Great as a snack, salad topper, or ground into plant-based butters.
effects: A crunchy, toasty burst that leaves a pleasant oily nuttiness.
Satisfying and filling, they make a dense plant-protein snack.

name: Dried Pandan Leaves Bundle
descriptions: A small bundle of fragrant pandan leaves, dried for storage; aromatic notes of vanilla and green pandan.
Used as a flavoring for rice, desserts, and beverages across Southeast Asia.
Not typically eaten in large amounts — used to infuse aroma into dishes.
effects: Adds a lifted, floral-vanilla aroma to whatever it steeps into.
Gently elevates the aroma of desserts and coconut-based dishes without adding heaviness.

name: bag of white rice (1 kg)
descriptions: A tightly sealed 1 kg bag of long-grain white rice — dry, starchy, and extremely versatile once cooked.
Staple grain that stores well and can be prepared in many ways: boiled, steamed, or fried.
effects: A plain bowl of cooked rice is filling and quietly comforting.
Dry rice is dense and not thirst-quenching by itself, but provides steady calories when prepared.

name: bag of dried lentils (500 g)
descriptions: A 500 g pouch of dried lentils — cooks quickly and provides protein and fiber.
Ideal for soups, stews, or simple one-pot meals.
effects: Nutty and earthy when cooked; a hearty, protein-rich base for meals.
Lentils rehydrate and become filling with a satisfying texture.

name: bag of dried black beans (500 g)
descriptions: A 500 g bag of dried black beans — high in protein and very filling after soaking and cooking.
Long shelf life and pairs well with rice, soups, and salads.
effects: Rich and hearty when cooked; dense, sustaining, and good for slow-cooked dishes.
Takes longer to prepare but yields a substantial portion of protein and fiber.

name: rolled oats (500 g)
descriptions: Half-kilogram of rolled oats — useful for porridge, baking, or adding to smoothies.
Cooks quickly and is a common breakfast staple providing soluble fiber.
effects: Warm oatmeal soothes and fills you up; raw oats give a chewy, nutty bite.
Absorbs liquids well, making it a good base for hydrating breakfasts.

name: dried pasta
descriptions: A 500 g pack of dried durum wheat pasta — cooks quickly to yield a filling meal component.
Neutral flavor that pairs with sauces, vegetables, and legumes.
effects: A warm bowl of pasta is filling and comforting; ideal for stretching other ingredients.
Dry pasta is calorically dense and satisfying once cooked.

name: canned tomatoes (400 g)
descriptions: A 400 g can of crushed tomatoes — pre-cooked and ready to use in sauces, stews, and soups.
Provides acidity, moisture, and vegetable flavor without refrigeration until opened.
effects: Bright, slightly acidic tomato flavor adds moisture and vitamin-rich body to meals.
Can be eaten cold or heated; a quick way to add vegetables to a dish.

name: jar of peanut butter (340 g)
descriptions: A 340 g jar of smooth peanut butter — calorie-dense, rich in fats and plant protein.
Good for sandwiches, sauces, or as a high-energy spread.
effects: Thick and rich; a small spoonful is very filling and provides sustained energy.
Oily texture and concentrated calories make it useful for boosting meal energy quickly.

name: all-purpose flour (1 kg)
descriptions: A 1 kg bag of all-purpose wheat flour — an ingredient for baking bread, pancakes, and thickening sauces.
Not typically eaten alone; requires cooking or processing into baked goods.

name: vegetable oil (1 L)
descriptions: A 1 L bottle of neutral vegetable oil — used for frying, baking, and adding calories to dishes.
Long shelf life when kept sealed and stored away from heat.

name: Hummus & Veggie Pack
descriptions: A reusable container of creamy chickpea hummus with carrot, cucumber, and celery sticks for dipping.
Fresh, crisp vegetables paired with a protein-rich plant spread — ready to eat and portable.
effects: The crunchy vegetables and smooth hummus make for a satisfying, savory bite.
You feel pleasantly full and refreshed after finishing the pack.

name: Quinoa & Roasted Vegetable Salad
descriptions: A chilled bowl of fluffy quinoa mixed with roasted sweet potato, bell pepper, kale, and a lemon-tahini dressing.
High-fiber and nutrient-dense, designed as a filling, plant-based meal.
effects: The roasted vegetables and warm quinoa balance each other for a hearty, comforting mouthfeel.
Eating it leaves you steadily energized and satisfied for hours.

name: Roasted Veg Sandwich on Whole Grain
descriptions: Toasted whole-grain bread layered with roasted zucchini, peppers, eggplant, and a smear of avocado.
A convenient handheld meal with a mix of textures — crisp bread, soft roasted veg, creamy avocado.
effects: Warm roasted vegetables and avocado create a balanced savory bite.
Fills you comfortably while delivering steady, long-lasting energy.

name: Fruit Compote & Oat Jar
descriptions: A mason jar layered with lightly stewed seasonal fruit compote, rolled oats, and a touch of maple.
Sweet but wholesome — works as breakfast or a dessert-like snack.
effects: Warm fruit and creamy oats feel comforting and slightly indulgent.
Leaves a pleasant light sweetness without being overly heavy.

name: Trail Mix Bag
descriptions: A resealable bag of mixed almonds, cashews, pumpkin seeds, and dried cranberries.
Calorie-dense, shelf-stable snack for quick energy between meals.
effects: Crunchy, slightly sweet, and very filling for its size.
Gives a concentrated boost of energy and satiety when munched.

name: Chia Pudding Cup (almond milk)
descriptions: Silky chia seed pudding made with almond milk and a hint of vanilla, topped with fresh berries.
A nutrient-rich dessert or snack with omega-3s and fiber.
effects: The gelatinous chia texture is creamy and filling; berries add a fresh bite.
Feels hydrating and satisfying without heaviness.

name: Cold-Pressed Green Juice (bottle)
descriptions: A chilled bottle of blended spinach, cucumber, celery, green apple, and lemon.
Low-residue, nutrient-packed beverage meant to refresh and hydrate.
effects: Bright, slightly tart vegetal flavors that wake up your palate.
Quickly quenches thirst while delivering a light vitamin boost.

name: Garden Mixed Greens Salad
descriptions: A ready-to-eat container of mixed baby lettuces, spinach, shaved cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes and a light lemon vinaigrette on the side.
Crisp, lightly dressed greens packaged for immediate eating; single-serving 300 g portion.
Keeps chilled; best eaten cold for maximum crunch and freshness.
effects: You take a forkful of crisp leaves and cucumber; the bright lemon vinaigrette wakes your palate and leaves a clean, refreshing finish.
The crisp texture and mild bitterness of the greens make it feel very light but clearly satisfying — a tidy, revitalizing bite.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
descriptions: Hearty blend of cooked chickpeas, diced cucumber, red onion, parsley and a drizzle of olive oil and lemon.
Protein-forward plant-based salad, ready to eat from a sealed tub; ~350 g serving.
Satisfying texture with a slight tang from the citrus and vinegar dressing.
effects: Each spoonful is pleasantly substantial — the chickpeas give a nutty bite while lemon and herbs brighten the mouth.
You feel content quickly; the texture and savory notes produce a steady, filling sensation without heaviness.

name: Quinoa & Roasted Vegetable Bowl
descriptions: A warm-style ready-to-eat bowl with fluffy quinoa, roasted sweet potato, zucchini, bell peppers and a tahini drizzle.
Higher-calorie plant-based meal intended as a filling lunch; ~450 g portion.
Hearty and warming flavors from roasted vegetables; best eaten at room temperature or slightly chilled.
effects: The roasted sweet potato and quinoa make each bite substantial and comforting, with a gentle richness from tahini.
You feel noticeably more full and sustained after a few mouthfuls — it's a proper, filling plant-based meal.

name: Tropical Fruit Medley Cup
descriptions: Cubed pineapple, mango, papaya and banana tossed with a squeeze of lime; single-serve fresh fruit cup.
Bright, juicy and ready to eat with a fork or spoon; ~275 g serving.
High water content for a refreshing snack or dessert.
effects: Juice bursts on the tongue with each bite — intensely sweet and tangy, cooling and bright.
The high water and natural sugars instantly refresh and uplift your senses; it feels hydrating and lively.

name: Berry & Plant Yoghurt Parfait
descriptions: Layers of blueberries, strawberries and raspberries over coconut or oat-based yoghurt with a sprinkle of granola.
Balanced sweet-and-tart parfait in a portable cup; ~300 g serving.
Creamy texture contrasted by crunchy granola for a pleasant mouthfeel.
effects: The tangy berries cut through the creamy plant yoghurt, while the granola adds a satisfying crunch.
It feels indulgent but light — a sweet treat that still leaves you moderately satisfied and energized.

name: Avocado & Tomato Open Sandwich
descriptions: Whole-grain slice topped with mashed avocado, ripe tomato slices, lemon and microgreens; ready to eat.
Single savory snack-size open sandwich packaged for grab-and-go.
Creamy avocado and juicy tomato combine to create a filling, flavorful bite.
effects: The richness of mashed avocado coats your mouth while tomato adds a bright, juicy contrast.
It provides a satisfying, sustaining sensation — hearty enough to feel like a small meal.

name: Rainbow Coleslaw with Apple
descriptions: Shredded red and green cabbage, carrot and thin apple ribbons tossed in a light apple-cider dressing.
Crisp, slightly sweet slaw packaged for immediate consumption; ~280 g serving.
Firm texture and bright acidity make it a refreshing side or light stand-alone salad.
effects: Crunchy cabbage and crisp apple give a lively, slightly sweet bite that feels clean and brisk.
You feel refreshed and mildly satiated — the sugar from apple offers a small energy lift without heaviness.

name: Chilled Cucumber & Mint Soup
descriptions: Smooth chilled soup made from blended cucumber, fresh mint, lime juice and a touch of olive oil; served cold.
Very hydrating, light portion suitable as a starter or cooling snack; ~250 ml serving.
Delicate herbal aroma and a cooling mouthfeel.
effects: A cold spoonful slides across your tongue with a cooling mint snap and watery cucumber freshness.
Immediately hydrating and soothing, it feels like a refreshing reset on a warm day.

name: apple slice
descriptions: A single thin slice of crisp red apple, skin on, ready to eat.
Sweet-tart and slightly crunchy with visible juice along the cut edge.
effects: You bite into the apple slice; a sweet-tart crunch releases cool, juicy flavor that refreshes your mouth.
The crisp texture wakes up your senses without feeling heavy.

name: orange wedge
descriptions: A single wedge of peeled orange, segments intact and easy to pop into your mouth.
Bright citrus aroma, dripping slightly with sweet-tart juice.
effects: You eat the orange wedge; the burst of bright, acidic juice is instantly refreshing and hydrating.
Its tangy sweetness leaves a clean, zesty aftertaste.

name: banana slice
descriptions: A single round slice from a ripe banana, soft and slightly sweet.
Creamy texture with gentle banana aroma, ready to chew.
effects: You pop the banana slice in your mouth; its soft, slightly mushy texture and mellow sweetness feel comforting.
It provides a quick, mellow energy lift without any sharp flavors.

name: cucumber slice
descriptions: A thin round slice of cucumber, crisp and cool.
Mild flavor with high water content, often served chilled.
effects: You eat the cucumber slice; it feels cool and watery, leaving a clean, vegetal taste.
Its crisp snap is light and very refreshing.

name: carrot stick
descriptions: A single stick of raw carrot, peeled and cut for snacking.
Firm and crunchy with a naturally sweet, earthy flavor.
effects: You crunch the carrot stick; the firm texture and sweet-earthy notes make it satisfyingly substantial.
It leaves a lingering crispness that feels wholesome.

name: celery stalk
descriptions: A single short stalk of celery, washed and trimmed.
Very fibrous and crunchy with a mild, slightly bitter green flavor.
effects: You chew the celery stalk; its pronounced crunch and watery snap is refreshing though slightly bland.
The fibrous texture feels invigorating but not filling.

name: tomato slice
descriptions: A single thin slice of ripe tomato, juicy and slightly tangy.
Soft flesh with seeds and a fresh garden aroma.
effects: You eat the tomato slice; the juicy, slightly acidic flesh coats your mouth with fresh, savory-sweet flavor.
Its tender texture is lightly satisfying without being heavy.

name: pineapple chunk
descriptions: A single bite-sized chunk of ripe pineapple, bright yellow and juicy.
Sweet with a sharp, tropical tang and fibrous texture.
effects: You bite the pineapple chunk; a rush of sweet-tart juice and tropical acidity tingles your tongue.
Its fibrous bite leaves a lively, vibrant aftertaste.

name: watermelon wedge
descriptions: A small triangular wedge of watermelon with rind removed from the tip.
Extremely juicy, sweet, and cooling — perfect for warm weather snacks.
effects: You take a bite of the watermelon wedge; an immediate wave of sugary, cool juice floods your mouth and refreshes you thoroughly.
Its light flesh feels hydrating and surprisingly filling for its weight.

name: strawberry (single)
descriptions: One ripe strawberry, hulled and ready to eat whole.
Sweet-fragrant with a soft, slightly seedy exterior.
effects: You pop the strawberry into your mouth; its juicy sweetness and bright aroma provide a quick, delightful burst of flavor.
The soft texture is pleasant and not filling.

name: bell pepper slice
descriptions: A single slice of raw bell pepper, crisp and colorful.
Mildly sweet with a snappy texture and glossy skin.
effects: You chew the bell pepper slice; its bright, slightly sweet flavor and crisp bite are pleasantly crunchy.
It feels light and uplifting rather than filling.

name: grape (single)
descriptions: A single seedless grape, firm-skinned and juicy.
Small, sweet, and perfect for popping in your mouth as a tiny snack.
effects: You pop the grape; it bursts with sweet juice that gives a quick, pleasant hit of flavor.
Tiny and light, it doesn't fill you but provides a momentary sugar lift.
